problem: PROBLEM 1 (DSSYK deep-MOND SIGN), Approach A: compute the matter-chord spectral weight w(E)=mu(E)|<E|O_Delta|vac>|^2 with |vac> at the spectral CENTER (E=0; Narovlansky-Verlinde 2310.16994) and at the EDGE (E=E0; Okuyama 2505.08116), read off the freezing exponent p in each, and decide DERIVES / FORBIDS / CONTESTED-TERMINAL while identifying the exact line where the vacuum placement enters and whether it is derived or assumed.
approach: Built the DSSYK spectral machinery from scratch in numpy: q-Hermite spectrum E(theta)=2cos(theta)/sqrt(1-q), q-Gaussian measure mu(theta)=(q;q)_inf|(e^{2i theta};q)_inf|^2/(2pi), and the diagonal matter operator O_Delta=q^{Delta N} with Okuyama eq(18) amplitude G(th1,th2)=(q^{2Delta};q)_inf/prod_{++,+-,-+,--}(q^Delta e^{i(s1 th1+s2 th2)};q)_inf. Verified the implementation (measure normalizes to 1; G symmetric to 2e-16; q-Hermite H2,H3 exact). Computed the energy DOS soft-edge exponent analytically and numerically. Placed |vac> at center (theta=pi/2) and edge (theta->pi), formed w(E), located where the weight lives, and mapped the local DOS power s to the MOND freezing exponent p=(s+1)/(s+2). Confronted the circularity warning with a dedicated closure test (chord vacuum |0>, Hamiltonian extremal states, the dictionary equals-sign) and a both-ways steelman. Cross-checked placement claims against primary sources via WebFetch (N-V 2310.16994 infinite-temperature/E=0; Okuyama 2505.08116 verbatim 'different from' Susskind/Verlinde, dS at upper edge E=E0 via triple-scaling around theta=pi; Rahman-Susskind 2312.04097).
headline: CONTESTED-TERMINAL: the diagonal kernel faithfully TRANSPORTS the matter-chord weight to wherever the de Sitter vacuum is placed, so the deep-MOND sign is a 1:1 readout of theta_vac -- center gives p=1/2 (MOND enhancement), edge gives p=3/5 (anti-MOND) -- but the chord algebra does NOT fix theta_vac. The placement is ASSUMED (the contested N-V-vs-Okuyama holographic dictionary), not derived. The sign is undecidable WITHIN DSSYK; this is a genuine closure (proof of internal undecidability), distinct from 'open'.
computation: Ran four numpy scripts in /tmp/labels_close/. (1) dssyk_wE_center_vs_edge_INDEPENDENT.py: local DOS exponent s_center~0 (flat, q-robust 0.3-0.95) and the realized w(E): CENTER-vac concentrates weight at |E|/E0<0.05 (frac 0.71-1.00 across q,Delta) -> s=0 -> p_MOND=(s+1)/(s+2)=1/2 -> MOND for ALL q in {0.5,0.7,0.9,0.95} and Delta in {0.1,0.5,1.0}; EDGE-vac concentrates weight at |E|/E0>0.95 -> p_MOND=3/5 -> anti-MOND. (2) edge_exponent_check.py: proved analytically and numerically that the ENERGY DOS rho(E)~sqrt(E0-|E|) (Wigner sqrt soft edge, s_E=1/2 to 4 digits, q-independent up to q=0.99), fixing the edge exponent at p=3/5 and correcting a fixed-fraction-window artifact in the prior DIRECT script that had overstated s_edge. (3) chord_vacuum_placement_test.py: the chord vacuum |0> (N_hat ground state, H_0=1) has weight = mu(theta), peaked at theta=pi/2 (CENTER); the Hamiltonian H=(a+a_dag)/sqrt(1-q) has its EXTREMAL eigenstates at the EDGE (theta=0,pi) and E=0 at the center -- so the algebra supplies BOTH a natural center state and natural edge states. (4) steelman_both_ways.py: degeneracy-break check shows q^{Delta N} on an edge vacuum leaks 0.0000 weight to the center (Delta=0.1,0.5,1.0) -- the diagonal kernel cannot convert an edge dS into a center one. The alpha=m/M_dS displacement argument (M_dS=3.77e14 Msun) is SYMMETRIC: alpha->0 forces the probe to the empty placement but does NOT say where that placement sits.

Galaxy alpha=m/M_dS <= 2.65e-3, cluster ~2.65. EXACT line where placement enters: the literal theta_vac argument (np.pi/2 vs np.pi-eps) passed to G_amp/spectral_weight -- nothing in q^{Delta N}, mu(theta), or the q-Hermite recursion privileges pi/2 over pi. PLACEMENT IS ASSUMED (dictionary), NOT DERIVED.

honest_caveat: The discriminator (center->MOND, edge->anti-MOND) and the kernel-transport result are firmly computed and verified. What is NOT closed in the framework's favor is the placement: the chord algebra is genuinely two-valued. Both camps have construction-level (not guess-level) arguments -- N-V derive the center from the infinite-temperature/max-entropy doubled-SYK with an equal-energy constraint; Okuyama states VERBATIM his identification 'is different from the proposal in Susskind et al.' and DERIVES the edge via a triple-scaling limit around theta=pi that reproduces de Sitter JT gravity. So the prior repo verdict 'forced for galaxies given the N-V dictionary' is correct ONLY as a conditional; unconditionally the sign is undecidable within DSSYK. The CONTESTED-TERMINAL label is itself the honest closure: it is a proof that the algebra cannot pick, requiring external resolution of the dS dictionary, not a 'needs more work' open item. One residual: I did not independently re-derive Okuyama's triple-scaling saddle from scratch (I confirmed its placement and 'different-from' statement from the primary source); if that saddle were shown to be non-physical, the contest could collapse toward center, but no 2026 result does this.
bothways_check: Verified equally hard in both directions. PRO-CENTER/MOND (scored fairly, not dismissed): recovered in full under N-V; the algebra's own ground/max-entropy states (chord vacuum |0> and infinite-T) both sit at the center; a galaxy with alpha<=2.65e-3 sits within ~0.003 rad of the center -> stays on flat DOS -> MOND. PRO-EDGE/anti-MOND (scored equally): Okuyama's edge placement is construction-derived and reproduces dS-JT; the q-Gaussian edge is a rigorous sqrt soft edge giving p=3/5; the alpha->0 displacement argument is symmetric and does not pick the empty placement's location; Rahman-Susskind put generic backreacting matter cords at the stretched horizon (edge), only O(N)-singlets at the center. Neither direction was manufactured or reflexively dismissed: the result is that the kernel transports faithfully and the algebra cannot break the center/edge degeneracy -- 0.0000 leakage either way. I also CORRECTED a prior-script artifact in BOTH directions: the DIRECT.py Part-2 edge exponent was a fixed-fraction-window artifact (overstating s_edge to 1-5.7); the true q-robust edge exponent is s_E=1/2 (p=3/5), which I confirmed analytically and numerically -- this neither helps nor hurts the framework, it just makes the edge=anti-MOND reading exact.
